claim_verbatim: The extended contrast is higher on every test set at every layer.
We extracted activations at the 'No' (layer 20) and projected them onto the same persona contrasts. At that token, the contrast's sign stops being the same on every dataset.
On IT it flips: the extended contrast falls from 0.990 on the response tokens to 0.173 at the 'No'. On HP-KR the repair is lost, falling from 0.882 to 0.190.

The Follow-Up Probe itself, a probe trained on RepE at the same token, has the same trouble with HP-KR. It scores 0.088 AUROC there, and at the Alpaca threshold it flags 88% of HP-KR's honest answers.
What the model carries forward to a self-report is not the same signal as the one its response carries.

For ranking, the mean is close to the best read on most datasets. The exception is CG at depth ... Read at its maximum, CG scores 0.993 at layer 40 against 0.912 for the mean, and 0.991 against 0.859 at layer 44.
For detection at the benchmark's threshold, the top-10% read is best. At layer 40 it reaches 0.737 balanced accuracy and 0.531 recall, against 0.694 and 0.413 for the mean.
